test_title: PYST 08: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct direct speech form of the following sentence.

Ravi requested his friend to turn the music down.

options.text: Ravi said, "Will you please turn the music down?"
Ravi said to his friend, "Are you going to turn the music down?"
Ravi said to his friend, "I request you to turn the music down."
Ravi said to his friend, "Please turn the music down."

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** Ravi requested his friend to turn the music down.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"requested his friend" becomes "Please turn the music down"**
 
 
• The reporting verb "requested" is converted to "please" in direct speech to retain the polite tone.
 
• The phrase "to turn the music down" is converted directly into a quoted request.
 
 
 
• **Reporting clause:**
 
 
• Indirect: "Ravi requested his friend"
 
• Converted to: "Ravi said to his friend," to maintain proper reporting structure.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Starts with a capital letter "Please" and ends with a period "." or appropriate punctuation.
 
• Reporting clause follows the quoted speech, separated by a comma.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Please turn the music down," said Ravi to his friend.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** Ravi said, "Will you please turn the music down?" 

 
 
• Changes the sentence into a question, which alters the meaning and does not match the original tone of a polite request.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** Ravi said to his friend, "Are you going to turn the music down?" 
 
 
• Turns the request into a question, which changes the intent of the sentence.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** Ravi said to his friend, "I request you to turn the music down." 
 
 
• Although grammatically correct, it is an unnatural way of phrasing a direct speech sentence.
